_comment: Manually-curated quality / owner conversations that DON'T produce a brain/calls/ note. The dashboard conversation metric scans brain/calls/*.md only, so in-person conference and luncheon conversations (no Granola transcript — captured as entity engagement notes / Attio) are invisible to it. Kay (or the conference-engagement / relationship pipeline) appends an entry per meaningful conversation here. 'type': 'owner' = an actual target business owner/seller; 'quality' = a meaningful deal-relevant connector/intermediary/peer (counts toward Quality conversations but NOT Owner conversations). Dates ISO (YYYY-MM-DD), the date the conversation happened. Dedup against brain/calls/ is by date+name — if a call note later appears for the same person/date, remove that manual entry.
_schema: conversations[]: {date, name, type: owner|quality, venue, note, entity}
